scope: Reviewed structured feat spell facts and our own concise instructions. No source entries.

spellPackages.name: Bard ritual book

choices.usage: Ritual only; hold your ritual book and add 10 minutes

spellPackages.instructions: The initial two spells must be level-1 rituals from the selected list. Record additional written rituals after resolving copying: 2 hours and 50 gp per spell level. Copied spells must match this list and ritual tag; the copying level limit is half character level, rounded up. This control spends no coins and grants no ordinary slot casting.

choices.usage: Always prepared; cast as a ritual or use an appropriate spell slot

auxResources.name: Quick Ritual
auxResources.description: Choose one prepared ritual spell and cast it using its normal casting time, without a slot or the extra ritual time. This counter records the use; it does not cast the spell.

spells.instructions: The number of selected level-1 rituals follows Proficiency Bonus. They are always prepared and use the ability increased by this feat. Quick Ritual recovers on Long Rest; ordinary ritual casting has no use pool.

grants.usage: Once per Long Rest; may also use an appropriate spell slot

choices.usage: Invoke this known rune once per Long Rest without a slot or material components; its marked object must be worn or carried. Spell slots may also be used while the rune is available.

spells.instructions: Choose runes equal to half Proficiency Bonus, rounded down. At Long Rest, inscribe each known rune on a touched eligible nonmagical object. Mark a rune available only while its inscribed object is on your person; otherwise its spell is inactive. Change known runes only when gaining a level. Comprehend Languages has a separate daily use.

grants.usage: Always prepared; one free casting per Long Rest; appropriate slots may also be used

spells.instructions: Whenever you cast Fog Cloud, extinguish nonmagical flames in its sphere. Creatures other than you and your allies have Speed reduced by 5 ft while inside; resolve occupants and movement at the table.

grants.usage: Always prepared; one free casting per Long Rest; appropriate slots may also be used

spells.instructions: You have Advantage on attack rolls against Charmed creatures. Confirm the target condition before rolling; no permanent attack bonus is added.

ability.label: Prestidigitation ability · agree with your DM

grants.usage: At will; stage-magic effects may conceal verbal and somatic components as ordinary conversation and card handling

choices.activationLabel: This card was imbued at my last Long Rest and is still within its 8-hour duration
choices.label: Hidden Ace spell
choices.usage: Hidden Ace: prepare at Long Rest; lasts 8 hours. A Bonus Action casts the card spell and consumes the card. Resolve spell components and any spell-slot cost with your DM; this counter does not waive them.

spells.instructions: A card deck can be your spellcasting focus. Hidden Ace must be on an actual class spell list, have a 1-action casting time and be a level for which you have slots. Class learning/preparation reach does not restrict this card choice. Confirm preparation and the 8-hour duration explicitly; Long Rest clears that confirmation. The source does not explicitly waive a spell-slot cost. Choose the spellcasting ability agreed with your DM. Hidden Ace uses the selected class's actual casting ability and class spell bonuses; the separate reviewed ability applies only to Prestidigitation.

grants.usage: Ritual only; add 10 minutes and provide the normal components. Choose the mascot for your selected Strixhaven college; this ritual has no daily casting limit.

auxResources.name: Mascot Teleport Swap
auxResources.description: Action: swap places with your mascot familiar within 60 ft. A destination too small causes failure and still wastes the use. After the free daily use, pay a level-2-or-higher slot explicitly for each further swap; leave this free-use counter spent. Replacing one of your Attack-action attacks lets the mascot attack with its Reaction.

spells.instructions: Complete Strixhaven Initiate and its college first. Find Familiar is a ritual, with no extra free pool; choose the ritual casting ability agreed with your DM. Keep the companion's own HP and reaction. Teleport positions, distance and destination size are resolved at the table; a further swap requires an explicitly spent level-2-or-higher slot.

grants.usage: Conditional feat transformation only; use the dedicated Misty Escape controls after a nonfatal drop to 0 HP. This is not a normal free-casting grant.

auxResources.name: Misty Escape
auxResources.description: Confirm a nonfatal drop to 0 HP in Misty Escape controls. Activation sets HP to 1 and starts a self-only Gaseous Form with flight 20 ft and 10 HP regeneration on your own turns. Concentration and duration end explicitly; one use per Long Rest.

spells.instructions: Use the dedicated Misty Escape controls, not ordinary spell casting. The trigger requires damage reducing you to 0 HP without killing you outright. Remain at 1 HP and cast Gaseous Form on yourself without an action or slot. Flight is 20 ft; heal 10 HP at the start of your turns. Concentration and the 1-hour duration still apply.
